summary: Froze the original three quoting policies, engine fingerprint, outcomes and fixed sample in an auditable plan. Compared 32 new paired seeds per regime (288 policy runs), reporting pointwise Student-t intervals for liquidated net, average absolute inventory, liquidation costs, fees and peak inventory. Added three studio cases with charts, interval tables, CSV exports and seed outcomes. All six candidate-versus-symmetric contrasts retain lower net with lower inventory exposure under the synthetic assumptions.
